entities.name: Zeynep Fadıllıoğlu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zeynep Fadıllıoğlu is a Turkish designer and owner of a Turkish architecture and interior design company. She designed the interiors of Istanbul's Şakirin Mosque in 2009 to wide international acclaim, possibly becoming the first woman to design a mosque.
